subtasks.objective: Add POS v2 table-attention status so occupied tables older than the POS Profile tableAttention threshold are visually marked red instead of only amber/occupied.
subtasks.acceptance: When POS Profile tableAttention is set and an occupied table's latest_invoice_time exceeds that threshold, TableCard renders the attention/red state with a clear attention badge; occupied tables below the threshold keep the existing occupied/warning state, available tables keep the existing available/success state, and missing/invalid thresholds or timestamps do not mark attention. The implementation includes focused coverage or a documented manual verification for threshold edge cases and the POS workspace typecheck passes.
